request.text: I want a new Wi-Fi iPad mini with the A17 Pro chip and 64 GB internal storage. Deliver to Saida.

message:
Apple never made a 64GB iPad mini with A17 Pro: this generation starts at 128GB. The 64GB mini is the older A15 model.
• Abed Tahan: iPad mini 7 Wi-Fi 256GB, Starlight — $649.00, listed in stock. Delivery across Lebanon is advertised, but the Saida delivery fee and new condition are not explicitly confirmed.
• OutGeeked: iPad mini A17 Pro 128GB, Space Gray — $480.00, sold out. The shop confirms brand-new products; shipping is calculated at checkout.
My suggestion: choose the 256GB mini if you need one now, after confirming new condition and the delivery charge to Saida.

product.title: Apple iPad Mini A17 Pro (7th Gen, 2024)
product.description:
The Apple iPad mini 7 (A17 Pro) is sold out at OutGeeked right now. Tap Notify me above and we'll let you know when it's back in Space Gray, Starlight, Blue or Purple (128GB or 256GB). Want an iPad today? The iPad 11th Gen (A16) is available, with cash on delivery anywhere in Lebanon.
Why iPad mini (A17 Pro)
Ultraportable: 8.3-inch Liquid Retina display in a 293 g, 6.3 mm design.
A17 Pro chip: 30% faster CPU, 25% faster graphics and a 2x faster Neural Engine than the previous iPad mini.
Built for Apple Intelligence: Writing Tools, Image Wand and Clean Up, in supported languages.
Apple Pencil Pro: squeeze, barrel roll and haptic feedback, attached magnetically.
Faster connections: Wi-Fi 6E and USB-C with USB 3 speeds.
Good to know
Works with: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C) and Bluetooth keyboards, sold separately.
Compare models: see every Apple iPad at OutGeeked.
